title: Vegetative to generative1 (Vgt1) is an enhancer affecting flowering time and jasmonate signaling in maize by promoting the expression of Zea mays Related to APETALA 2.7.
authors: Zicola, Johan; Weber, Blaise; Tu, Xiaoyu; Bader, Rechien; Zisis, Dimitrios; Aesaert, Stijn; Salvi, Silvio; Krajewski, Pawel; Van Lijsebettens, Mieke; Li, Chuanshun; Li, Yangmeihui; Zhong, Silin; Scholten, Stefan; Turck, Franziska; Stam, Maike
one_liner_zh: 该文研究玉米Vgt1增强子通过DNA甲基化调控ZmRap2.7表达及开花时间，虽涉及增强子-启动子物理互作和TF结合靶基因，但核心是表观遗传调控与基因表达，缺乏AI或物理模拟方法，且非TF-DNA结合机制建模，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Transcriptional enhancers participate in cell and tissue differentiation in all multicellular organisms. Here, we characterized the candidate enhancer Vegetative to generative1 (Vgt1), a major quantitative trait locus for flowering time in maize. Transgenic lines containing an inverted repeat that induces DNA methylation at Vgt1 showed early flowering and an accelerated growth rate during early development. DNA methylation of Vgt1 was associated with the downregulation of the AP2-like floral repressor ZmRap2.7 in specific leaf tissues at the early stages of maize development. In line with Vgt1 regulating ZmRap2.7, chromosome conformation capture data showed that Vgt1 physically interacts with the ZmRap2.7 transcription start site. Finally, chromatin immunoprecipitation of transiently expressed ZmRap2.7 in protoplasts indicated that this transcription factor binds to the promoters of several hundred genes. These genes include many genes that are differentially expressed in maize lines with and without extra DNA methylation at Vgt1. Altogether, we show that ZmRap2.7 is transcriptionally controlled by Vgt1 and is involved in regulating flowering time and other biological pathways, such as jasmonate signaling.
abstract_zh: 转录增强子参与所有多细胞生物中的细胞和组织分化。在此，我们表征了候选增强子Vegetative to generative1（Vgt1），这是玉米开花时间的一个主要数量性状位点。含有反向重复序列的转基因系在Vgt1处诱导DNA甲基化，表现出早花和早期发育期间加速的生长速率。Vgt1的DNA甲基化与玉米发育早期特定叶片组织中AP2样开花抑制因子ZmRap2.7的下调相关。与Vgt1调控ZmRap2.7一致，染色体构象捕获数据显示Vgt1与ZmRap2.7转录起始位点发生物理相互作用。最后，在原生质体中瞬时表达的ZmRap2.7的染色质免疫沉淀表明，该转录因子结合数百个基因的启动子。这些基因包括在Vgt1处有无额外DNA甲基化的玉米品系中差异表达的许多基因。总体而言，我们表明ZmRap2.7受Vgt1转录调控，并参与调控开花时间及其他生物途径，如茉莉酸信号传导。
